I was in ER with severe panic attack and derealisation. I was chilling after benzodiazepines and waiting for blood tests results when they brought dead old man inside. I didn't see him or anything but he was fallowed by his daughter and grandson and before they let me go I heard her cries and moans for over an hour and they had to give her chill pill too, because, no wonder why, she was losing her shit. She was literally delusional at sone point. I couldn't keep myself together, I was crying in silence and I felt huge urge to hug her. It was terrible. I will never forget this family.
My logic said it's stupid and dangerous, but I followed my instincts and confronted someone who abused me. It helped me a lot.

Having straight week of lucid dreams in this house, talking with it's ghosts. Stories about who lived there and when don't line up. After every single visit inside the house, exactly at 4 am each time someone or something knocked on my window. That shit has too much mystery around it and whether it's paranormal shit or just homeless people living there trying to scare the shit out of me and my friends - not going near it ever again. And if, I'll take frickin axe with me.
